managementReviews.title: Management Reviews
managementReviews.description: Management oversight meetings and strategic decisions. Required by NIS2 Art. 20(1).
managementReviews.helpText: Document management review meetings where leadership evaluates cybersecurity posture. NIS2 Art. 20 makes management personally responsible for approving and overseeing cybersecurity measures. Record attendees, topics discussed, and decisions made.
managementReviews.empty: No management reviews recorded yet. Schedule your first review.
managementReviews.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this review?

fieldDescriptions.title: Title of the management review meeting (e.g., 'Q1 2025 Cybersecurity Review').
fieldDescriptions.reviewDate: Date when the management review meeting took place.
fieldDescriptions.decisions: Document key decisions made by management regarding cybersecurity posture, resource allocation, and risk acceptance.
fieldDescriptions.actionItems: List specific follow-up actions assigned during the review, including responsible parties and deadlines.
fieldDescriptions.nextReviewDate: Date when the next management review is scheduled. NIS2 Art. 20 requires ongoing management oversight.
